nom: The Ordinary Soothing & Barrier Support Serum for Sensitive Skin & Hydration

avis.texte: i used this every night for a week and it made my skin smoother and more even. it really works if you are consistent
I love this product it does what it say you have to be consistent with this product to see the results

avis.titre: Took my skin months to recover from this!
avis.texte: I stupidly used more than half of a bottle of this product before realizing it was the source of what look like acne on my chin. Red, bumpy, so dry it was flaking, hard to cover with makeup. Once I stopped using it, it took my skin 3-4 months to heal to where I no longer had the large, flaking, red acne on my chin. Horrible product for me, someone with sensitive skin no less!
Im prone to hormonal acne on my jawline, however this broke me out real bad across my entire forehead and cheeks

avis.titre: I never write reviews but I had to
avis.texte: OBSESSED w this. I'm 26 and have struggled for the last 3 years with dryness and eczema on my face. It was itchy, soooo uncomfortable and only $$$ derm creams seemed to help. This paired w the milky toner has CHANGED MY LIFE!! My skin is dewy, hydrated, and clearer than ever. It is truly such a gentle but effective product. I'm obsessed and will buy forever lol

Around my mid 30s my skin just totally changed if became extremely sensitive I've tried hundreds of different products and I've been using ordinary now for two years I've still messed around with a few other things that I've supposedly for sensitive skin, but they always seem to damage my face. This product has been extremely well for my sensitive skin. I'm 45 years old now and I take pride and having a useful complexion.

avis.titre: I would buy tis product again and again
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review.] The texture of it is great! 10/10The longevity is 15 - 30 minutes long 8.4/10 The Aroma is VERY, VERY, VERY SWEET! 15/10 THE Presentation is VEEERY LUXURIOUS! 10/10

I love this little Pepto Bismal looking serum. You know how Pepto calms your tummy? This does the same for your skin. I purchased it to use on my repair stages after retinal. It's so nice to put on and plumps my skin up. I even notice my skin still feels plump after I wake up and it's been sitting all night! No discomfort even after some rough skin treatments. I love it so much I will be repurchasing.

I am so happy that I finally decided to try this! It works amazingly! I have sensitive, dry, very acne prone skin. I can at anytime be dealing with redness and needing barrier repair. I accidently mixed a couple ingredients on my skin that I should not have and ended up burning a couple areas. This took those spots from red and stinging to calm, instantly sod and redness went way down within a day! The repairing happened that quick! This is now a staple in my routine. I think this is the best product Ordinary has. Oh and sidenote, I love the way it smells lol :) there's no fragrance added, of course— it's just the natural scent of it. :)

avis.titre: Makes my skin glow like no other!!
avis.texte: What really stands out about this product for me is that it really seems to enhance whatever I layer it with. Everything in my routine just seems to sink so much better into my skin when I layer this serum on, and it makes my face just so much more hydrated.

I have been dealing with the worst breakouts in years and my skin has felt so raw and sensitive. This was so calming and eased the raging inflammation that had taken over my face. I let it dry for a minute or two and followed it up with moisturizer (la roche double repair mousturizer) and can tell a difference that day. Who knew a serum the color of Pepto-Bismol could be so helpful?

avis.titre: So far I am loving this product
avis.texte: Calms some redness I have on my checks. Feels so smooth and hydrating, works well with other products to minimize my blemishes and pores.

At first I tried layering this serum with other serums and got a lot of redness. I almost tossed it, but tried it again with just an HA moisturizer on top and—wow. I struggle with dry patches on my cheeks in the winter and this gave me the soft, plump skin that I am barely able to achieve with a whole arsenal of (sometimes vastly more expensive) products. Sometimes less is more! This is now a winter staple for me. I even put a couple of drops on my sun-damaged forearms, which have been looking terrible this winter, and I'm amazed at how much better they look (temporarily). The only thing I'm not crazy about is the smell, which is kind of chemical-y. And what makes it pink? But I'll definitely repurchase!

avis.titre: 20/10, Fav INSANE Hydrating TREATMENT (not daily serum)
avis.texte: I've tried SEVERAL (25-30) hydrating serums within the past few years, a lot of them $80+ , yet this is my favorite one which I have been using for YEARS. However, I would not say this is a daily serum if you have overall oily or well-hydrated skin. If you have never tried this before, I would highly recommend using it only 2-3 times a week and slowly work your way up to see how much moisture you really need. OR even try just spot usage on the places that need the most moisture. I am 29 and have combination skin (oily t-zone + normal to dry skin everywhere else depending on the season), my skin is also very sensitive. When I first started using this, I used it every day and LOVED it bc it feels like your skin is literally chugged water that doesn't evaporate. However, I noticed that I started getting little bumps around my t-zone and around my nose. I realized after some time that this serum, for me at least, wasn't meant to be used as a daily/all-year/all over the face-use item. In the summer, I almost never use it, except maybe around my eyes before I applied an eye cream or for other spot treatment of dry areas. My skin gets super dry in the winter, and it becomes my DAILY serum for maybe a week every few weeks to bring back moisture to my face. More so like a treatment, if anything. (Literally nothing else I've tried only gives INSTANT moisture as deep as this. Nothing stops the peeling or itchy feeling on my face like this.) I will use a toner, apply this, then a hylauro
This serum absorbs nicely and soothed a couple of dry, red patches on my skin.
Personally didn't see a difference in my skin. However do not use this under makeup it will make it peel. Even if you rub your face it will peel

After using this product for a year I wasnt sure if it was doing anything for my skin until I stopped. It hydrates your skin really well. The product was helpful when applied before my retinol to offset the irritation and dryness. Its also offsets dryness when using benzoyl cleanser. Will always purchae.

i geuinley js buoght this because it was trending but then ny mol was loke ih whats thats ando was like oh i yhink its a redness serum and i pit dome on her hang and im not even kidding there was little- no redness i was shooed yo my core i out some in half my face and omg itd freaking insaneee

For the first couple of weeks of using this, my face would sting & get red right after applying it. It would sting for a couple of hours after applying, but I would leave it on. In a couple of weeks, my face stopped stinging & then greatly improved!

Had a terrible few months unable to find products that helped with new redness and skin sensitivity. I'm 35+ with evolving skin needs as I age and collect new allergies. Use this at night and the hyaluronic acid + Pacifica lotion in the morning and skin has never been better.
this is now an essential for me!! has helped my breakouts and eliminated the damaged skin barrier symptoms I was having
I use a lot of active ingredients with most of my skin care and this is perfect to sooth my skin after so many intense products and it leaves my skin so soft.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: It helped to calm the damaged skin on my face. I recommended this production to my niece.

After using for about 2 weeks, I can definitely see the noticeable change in my skin tone. It feels brighter, cleaner, and overall feels very calm. I notices that after applyign this product, my sunscreen pills over it. But since I actually like this product, I am willing to find a sunscreen that will work with it.

I extremely dry and sensitive skin and for a very long time havent found anything that worked for me until I added this into my routine! When I tell you its turned my red angry zitty patch completely around within just a few days I mean it! Its given me back the ability and confidence to wear makeup again because I no longer worry about an angry senstive flaky patch ruining my foundation. I use it along side the hyaluronic acid serum, together theyve worked wonders. Ive have no pilling but the smell is very pungent, but id deal with that any day to have clear skin.
I'm terrible at staying with a product. I'm always trying something else. But this will always be a part of my skincare routine!

I live in a really humid area so everytime winter hits the air dries up and my skin barrier goes with it. I'm talking Rango level shriveled up flakey, red, irritated- the whole 9 yards. The transition every year is always hard, but I saw this product from The Ordinary and didn't hesitate to try it. literally it helped my skin immediately, my skin felt plump and soft and I have yet to see any flakiness or dry patches break through after adding this to my routine. Kinda has a funny smell to it that makes me think of plastic but overall I will definitely be purchasing this again in the future.
I add this serum to my a deep moisture at night. When I wake up in the morning my skin is not red anymore and is hydrated. I have super sensitive and dry skin.

I have always had super-damaged and acne-prone skin. This cleared me up 95% in only two weeks. I use this every night before bed and it really has helped me so much. I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to have a simple skin care routine but clear up their skin quickly!
I'd give this one more try, but warning: it pills. Next time, I'll try using like... half a pea-sized amount. Otherwise, it works well on my skin.

I suffer from Rosacea, and in turn I experience acne as a result of a rosacea breakout - it's an unfortunate cycle. The soothing barrier support serum is THE ONLY affordable, quality product on the market (non Rx) that does an amazing job. It will help to eliminate the Redness from the Rosacea and keep your moisture barrier stronger, which is important for managing rosacea symptoms. It does take about 3-5 days to begin to see a difference, so be patient! It will restructure the surface of your skin (in a good way). You can wear it under moisturizer, sunscreen, makeup, etc. There is Not an oily texture, and the product smells natural and quickly absorbs into your skin when applied. 10/10 for The Ordinary on this one.

The Ordinary is the only brand I use for my skin and hair. After trying several other products from The Ordinary, I decided to give this one a try, but it was a complete disappointment. It caused rashes around my nose area. I tested it three separate times with gaps in between, but the same reaction occurred each time.

I tried lessening my useage of it to only once a day, to then twice a week, but my face was incredibly oily, to the point where my skin became severely dried out (worsening the issue of dead skin I was trying to fix beforehand) and my pores got clogged from all the excess oil on my face. Caused a bad acne breakout on my chin that is still healing. I would not recommend for oily or acne prone sensitive skin.
it broke me out so bad and can we please talk about the wax smell and the oily feeling after you put it on?

This really helped soothe my eczema and felt amazing on the dry, dehydrated areas of my face. But I did notice some breakouts in spots where my skin was already doing fine, so it's a bit of a mixed experience.

I've been using trentinoin for almost a year now, and for the days where my skin barrier is at its worse, this serum really helps!! it locks on mositure on my skin and really helps soothe my skin barrier. it's one of the only products that doesn't burn when I use it.

avis.titre: Like the product, not the smell
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a few weeks and my skin (oily and sensitive) seems to like it. The smell is awful though. It smells like jagermeister to me and I had too many jagerbombs in my 20s to want to experience that smell in my 30s.

avis.titre: Very good serum for dry sensitive skin
avis.texte: Ive been uaing this for a few months now. I use it as my third serum on my non- strong product nights either on its own or mixed with squalane. Just one or two drops is enough. Seems to soothe the dry red patches on my chin. I use very strong products every other night as im over 40 so this is a great way to restrengthen my skin barrier so i can keep using the other strong products. I had to test this product for one week. One drop on the inside of my elbow twice a day for at least 5 days and then wait another 2 days for a reaction. If your good then start using on your jawline for a few days. My skin is not so sensitive but i use strong priducts and sometimes they dont work well together. I recommend you do this as well with every product.

I was excited to have a serum for barrier repair. However, I had a similar issue as others who experienced a breakout within 1 day of using the serum. Disappointing. I haven't had this type of experience with other The Ordinary products though.
I started using this product that is supposed to be soothing and it stings my skin. It also smells like lumber very strongly
I use this serum alongside niacinamide and hylauronic acid and if I skip this one I can notice the difference! It leaves my skin more even and plump looking after just one use.
I love this product so much. I could definitely see a difference in my skin, but I hate the smell and it makes my skin Pink if you want to use this I would recommend only using it at night.

I love this product. after cleaning my face in the am , i apply this to my face and neck and it makes it feel more hydrated and dewy . I love a product that makes my dry skin feel healthier. Plus the color is fun.

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. This product I don't use everyday. It certainly does as advertised, but I'll skip it if I'm in a hurry.

Highly recommend this for dryness and peeling caused by prescription acne treatment!! Bummed to see some bad reviews on here, because I've had a great experience with this product. I have cystic acne and the topicals I use to help manage it are Winlevi (godsend) and Aklief, a .05% retinol prescription. The Aklief really dries out my skin (no surprise there) but it helps so much I didnt want to stop using it. So I searched for something to help balance the dryness and peeling I was experiencing and landed on this product from the ordinary. It makes such a difference! It says it restores the skin barrier within 2 hours of application and I really do notice it within that timeframe. Even better when I put it on at night and have some hours without makeup or other environmental issues attacking my face. I apply it right after the winlevi and aklief, and before moisturizer. Have not had any pilling. It goes on light and does not clog my pores. My only complaint is you have to make sure not to touch the sides of the bottle with the applicator because it does gum up on the outsides pretty quickly if you do. So just be careful when taking the applicator in and out of the bottle. But even that is not a complaint about the product itself, just the packaging. This is such good stuff and i hope they keep making it a long time! I'm about to switch up my moisturizer to one with spf in it and will report back on how that goes

I struggled with hormonal acne for months after quitting birth control, and not a single "acne clearing" product worked. I've thankfully never really struggled with breakouts in my life, until now in my mid-twenties, but this serum has worked and is still working wonders!!!!! My acne, not to mention the redness and uncontrollable itching it brings, has improved TREMENDOUSLY and I notice a visable difference overnight whenever I use this. 10000/10 🙌💖

avis.titre: great for sensitive skin, and tweens
avis.texte: I am 12 years old , and before this serum , I had tiny pimples on my forehead, and after I used this serum, all the tiny pimples went away after just 1 use .I would say that this product is definitely worth trying out .
I battle redness and sensitive skin and this product made it a lot worse. Terrible for rosacea in my case.

I feel like this is a good product to use before and after elemental/harsh weather days. I noticed a differnce in my skin feeling protected and nourished if I was in the wind or in the cold a lot. On just a regular day with no exposure, I dont think it's needed and would skip it. I have no complaints but probably wont buy it again.

i don't feel like this did anything for me; i didn't notice any (positive) difference in texture, redness, breakouts, whatever. the drydown is so fast i can't evenly distribute it around my face, plus it never seems to soak in so if my face rubs on anything (like my mask), it will leave pink marks behind and occasionally pill. i got through about 3/4 of the bottle before deciding i didn't want to deal with the frustration anymore. thinner serums just work better for me, i guess!

I wanted to like this so bad but it pills too much. Ive tried it with my skinscare rountine (in combination with other serums and creams) and by itself and no matter what i do it pills off my face. Its like it leaves a pink film that doesn't ever quite absorb. I do find it to have a calming effect on my skin though but due to the pilling and odd smell I wont repurchase.

I use this serum for my dry hands and it works amazing but when I try it on my face my skin would break out and it would get sensible to other things. I really wanted to like it but definitely everybody is different.
I bought this having high hopes from social media but after 2 weeks I had suck bad break outs and made my skin so oily

I never write reviews but this product has literally changed my life. I have horrible red patches , rosacea and it has DRASTICALLY improved the redness. Almost instantly after the first few uses. I have tried SO MANY redness products and this is BY FAR the best. Not paid to say this just truly grateful I found something that helps my redness I have been battling for years
Its so easy to use. A little goes a long way and its calming. It does not irritate my skin at all. My skin feels moisturized and it makes my skin glow.

avis.titre: My problem skin LOVES this product!
avis.texte: Based on the reviews it seems like your skin will either love or hate this. My skin loves it. I have difficult skin that is somehow dry, acne prone, oily, and sensitive all at once. It can be very hard to find products to fix one problem without making another worse. There seems to be a lot of recent hype about barrier support skincare, and this seemed like a good way to try it without spending a lot. I added this to my skincare routine morning and night without changing anything else and it has gotten rid of my flakiness, old acne spots, and new ones have not formed. And this is normally the time of month my skin is the worst (iykyk). In fact, I just recently switched to a lighter moisturizer for daytime since my skin is not so uncomfortable anymore and the oiliness has improved, too. I am so thrilled. And for the price it is worth a try!

I used this product in combination with the PM Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% also from Ordinary and it dried out my face. I do usually have dry skin, but this product made it worse. I was using this because i have rosacea on my cheeks and i do not wear any makeup. Very sad. My face is the driest its ever been.

This product is so calm on the skin, very soothing, has done serious magic on my skin when I have an eczema flare up. From very dry, flaky, scaly, pink/red angry skin, specifically my eyelid & my lower lid/designer eye bags. To as if nothing ever happened, healed, happy skin. You do have to be careful with how many steps are in your skincare or what you use with this, it will pill, granted it's pink but all of it will come off.

This product did nothing for my skin. It was always messy, the dropper leaked all the time no matter how I used it. Then the product would get dry and crusty around the outside of the bottle. I also didn't like that it stayed sticky on my skin for a long time.

I wanted to love this so much, I really like how it initially applies and feels on my skin, but after using it for twk weeks my skin is so congested! I have little red bumps all over my face that have continued to show up. I stopped using it for two days and its already started clearing. I had high hopes after seeing it all over social media but am left disappointed ☹️

avis.titre: Gold star in my routine now
avis.texte: I have been using this about a month now and my skin has literally been glowing. While it does take a good five minutes to completely dry down and absorb with my toner underneath, it is completely worth the results. I haven't noticed any sort of pilling or anything out of the ordinary that may mess with my regular makeup on a day to day. I was apprehensive and tend to ignore fads or trends from the internet and bought this on a whim since I was struggling this winter with dry skin due to my environment.
It claims to sooth redness and irritation but it did the opposite, left my skin feelign HOT and congested
It claims to sooth redness and irritation but it did the opposite, left my skin feelign HOT and congested

avis.titre: I use this product ever night!
avis.texte: It works so nice it's so nice and gentle on my skin and i have VERY sensitive skin but it doesn't make me break out!

I wish I had purchased this product sooner! I have VERY sensitive skin and this product does not irritate me whatsoever. I've seen a significant reduction in acne since using this. I like it much better than the Cocokind Ceramide Barrier Serum. If you have sensitive skin, give it a try!

avis.titre: Jury is still out on this one
avis.texte: I feel somewhat fresh and glow-y the morning after I use this. However, when I do my toner, I see a lot of the pink wiping off more like a mask than a serum that soaks in. Maybe that's the point though..? It also has a little bit of a sulphur smell.

I was having reactions to everything and my face looked like i had severe acne it was so irritated. My skins super sensitive but no bad reaction to it at all, and it fixed my complexion in about a week. I pair it with a moisturizer. Doesnt dry oily, absorbs fully.

Okay, so i love the ordinary and their products but this serum really didn't do much for my face, even after i used it for weeks. The "skin barrier repairing" claim and the fact its pink was really just a marketing tactic, other than that its okay.
Love this product. It clears your skin and helps with unwanted texture and smoothness
I burn my skin regularly with strong retinol and this is the only product that repairs my skin barrier. It is truly magic and I will never not use it

avis.titre: I like it but it does not like me
avis.texte: I had purchased this because I heard it's good for rosacea. Started having sensitivity on my nose but thought that might be my makeup (which I only wear occasionally) so I repurchased when I ran out. Halfway through the second bottle and my nose broke out in hot red bumps that made me look like Rudolph for a few days. Also got the bumps where I have some texture/acne scarring in my T zone. Seems this is just not the product for me and my sensitive, dry skin. Guess I'll just try something hydrating in the future and pay closer attention to how my skin reacts.

i have battled with acne and hyperpigmentation due to scarring on my cheeks for 5 years now. recently i've dealt with skin like bumps that cause an insecurity. i figured with the winter time being here, my skin barrier was damaged. i was right! reached for this product and after ONE use i saw a change in texture and evenness of my skin. did not break me out or cause irriation either. 10/10 reccomend:))
It was hydrating but after day 2 or using it caused me to break out in little bumps

Definitely one of the best things my skin has had in a while. Its the only thing I changed in my skincare routine, and my skin is visibly smoother, less red, and just feels so soft and strong. Been using it twice a day for almost 3 weeks now, my discoloration has been strides

I have rosacea and acne, the worst combination. Anything that helps acne flares the rosacea. Ive been gradually fialingnup retinol and this serum has helped soothe my skin and help me be consistent.. overalm I've achieved clear healthy skin. If you have skin issues you've got to try out products until uouve basically finished the bottle to really know. Ive used 3 bottles and KNOW this works for me.

So i have sensitive skin and my skin is red because of it so i was at ulta with my dad and decided to buy it when i got home I started using it fast forward to like a week laternmy skin is not red and it looks great and i was shocked cause anything like that makes my skin burn and it didn't

I have very dry, roseca prone, sensitive skin. I've tried SO MANY products and wasted so much money. This serum paired with the ordinary azelaic acid completely repaired my skin. Helped the redness, stopped the dryness, healed the barrier. Noticeable difference just in 24 hours and it only got better. I'm now finishing my first bottle of each product. It worked so well I just ordered 3 more of each. 5 stars.

So I am 26 years old and have been theiugh the ringer with oily skin with dryness patches and sensitivety to acids. I actually used to have to test products on my wrist since i could accidentally chemical burn my face, since i had no skin barrier left from all the poor skin maintence in my teens. I wanted something to help with redness and naturally heal my skin instead of the chemicalized 1 stop shop products, that are expensive and end up not working for me. Over the last 6 months ive seen significant decrease in redness in my t zone. It was not over night but gradual in about 30 day increments for me to see a difference. I adore how rhis product makes my skin feel so much so that ive switched all my skin care (except face wash) to ordinary products.

I have combination but very acne prone skin. My skin gets so dry in the winter and this is one of the only hydrating products that doesn't break me out. I literally never write reviews but I just had to buy this again after using it last winter. My skin was so dry and after using this twice today my skin is sooo soft. 100% recommend
This does amazingly well for my sensitive dry skin. I use this AM/PM, COSRX 96 and Aveeno excema lotion. It makes me face so soft and dewy!

I get reallyyy dry patches in the winter & this has helped so much! I apply after I wash my face in the am/pm. I could tell a difference in one day! I would 100% recommend this product to anyone who needs a little extra moisture boost without becoming greasy!!

I get reallyyy dry patches in the winter & this has helped so much! I apply after I wash my face in the am/pm. I could tell a difference in one day! I would 100% recommend this product to anyone who needs a little extra moisture boost without becoming greasy!!

I have extremely senstive skin. Something either burns, peels or breaks out in hives. I did none of those things with this. Prob the first product ive been able to use. I was just diagnosed with roscea. This product seems to calm & mosturize, more than get rid of redness. But redness is a hard thing to get rid of, so i will give this grace. It sooths my skin amd gives me a nice glow! Im getting a cream from my derm. But she also suggested this line of products but the NOT the face peel! She said its too harsh on sensitive skin.

I have incredibly sensitive skin, shaving my face has always led to issues, especially on my neck due to easily ingrown hairs that grown nearly parallel to my skin surface. As a result, there are almost ALWAYS chewed up looking red spots and scabs on my neck that can never heal before shaving again. Simply 4 to 5 drops of this spread evenly over that area over shaving has my neck cleared up for the first time in years. I've also found this is great for any part of the body where the skin has been compromised and scabbed over. This in combo with the hyaluronic acid and niacinamide and a good lotion has left me feeling confident about my face consistently and I'm simply over the moon about it < 3

I DESTROYED my skin barrier from working in ovens and walk-in freezers. Nothing seemed to repair it, til i found this! It took a few weeks of regular use, but i just finished my first bottle and the results are amazing. Great for Rosacea, sunburns, chapped winter skin, and pretty much any type of skin irritation. VERY calming and soothing.
I love the way it feels when applied. Not sticky or drying. I use it every day!
My face was extremely red and irritated. This product calmed it overnight
This worked so well to heal my acne. My skin barrier was in pretty rough shape and I struggled with acne for a while, but after I started using this serum it's healed so much! 10/10 would recommend!

So I've used this for almost a week. I figured I'd see something special immediately because its so expensive for this brand. My face looks and feels nearly the same except I now dont get greasy like their regular moisturizer gets me greasy. It also smells like wet paint yall. I'm not exaggerating or kidding even a little bit. It smells EXACTLY like you freshly painted the walls. The smell does dissipate fairly quickly (within thirty minutes or less). Im hoping to get better results as time goes on. Other moisturizer's have given me quicker results than this. And yes, I've researched this product and am using it appropriately and with the products I'm supposed to use in conjuction with it. Yes, I'm also using the appropriate amount. I've used the Ordinary products for years and love them. Hopefully I'll love this one too.
It made my skin feel soft and it was shiny however i noticed my forehead was breaking out more after 3 days of using it and it made my cheek itch all day

Now first thing i wanted to get this product because i wanted to use it on my days i used my actives but i can say it dose a good job at making my face really soft, smooth and hydrated i wanted to use it in my normally routine and atfer awhile i started to see little bumps come in around my month and chin and that was the only new thing i had started in my routine and right when i stopped useing it my face started to clear up i still use it just on my exfoliation nights but I wouldn't recommend it .

I want to start off my review by saying that my sensitive acne prone skin loved this product especially while on Trentinoin. However, the cap to this bottle is different from my other ordinary dropper bottles. It is so sharp. It has sliced my finger open multiple times while using this product probably will not purchase again.
Irritated my skin, dried it out, and it stings if you sweat even just a little while wearing it. I was trying to soothe my damaged skin barrier but this just made it worse!!

avis.titre: for the price it is a great product
avis.texte: I like using this on the inbetween days and it's been a great addition to my routine. There are better on the market, they also cost significantly more. Whomever said it leaves your skin pink is just nuts. LOL. For the price, give it a try.
Where this serum is hydrating, it was not soothing for me. It caused my skin to breakout with tiny red bumps all over, accompanied with heat and redness.

avis.titre: A yesss for my acne prone skin! Try it!
avis.texte: I have very acne prone skin when it comes to products… this actually helped the current breakout on my forehead to heal and appear less inflamed! Also it overall gave the skin a healthful and supple appearance! Will buy again if it continues to give me these results!

I really liked using this product at first because I admit, it cleared my skin a little bit but there are a bunch of cons. 1: Not good with makeup • If you love to do your makeup you would like to use this as one of your skin prep products I would reccomend you didn't. • When you blend your makeup the serum starts to peel/flake and its almost like little worms or pink dandruff on your face. (NOT CUTE) 2: Doesn't mix with spf/sunscreen • Again peels and looks like worms or pink dandruff when you rub sunscreen in after it. 3: Drys fast • At first you feel very refreshed and cooled on the skin but later on you'll feel dry or it'll make your skin shiny, literally your face will be stiff and shine like rubber!!!! That is all I have to say about this product for now but this is coming from someone with combination skin!!

avis.titre: Nope! Leaves red stuff on face and hands
avis.texte: Bought it, tried it, didn't like so put it away for two weeks. Tried it again. Not only did it leave a red glimmer on face, it was sticky and stiff feeling. No results except ewwww. Honestly, best products I have found after all these wanna be Ulta rip offs are the Oily of Olay ones at any drugstore

avis.titre: One of the first products to make a noticeable difference
avis.texte: Within a week of using this I could tell my skin looked nicer overall. I was not using to treat any specific concern, but found my skin looked more hydrated and plump. will buy again!
The packing is nice and had good benefits but it's pricey. I have acne prone skin and this cause so many small red bumps. This was the only product I used and after I stopped using it, it went away
I thought this product would be soothing, unfortunately I must have a sensitivity to an ingredient because I tried this product two times, a few months apart and I've had a reaction both times.

I had high hopes for this product, as I love The Ordinary products. However, I feel thos product needs to go back to have the kinks worked out of it. It goes on tacky and stays tacky all day on your face. It does get rid of a little red, but not enough that it's worth dealing with the stickiness of the product. I'm going back to using green BB cream.

.. and whoever says it does is lying. There's no dye in it. I just dripped a huge blob on a brand new white t-shirt and it came right out with just alil water. Ive also found that a little goes a long way and the less you use, the less likely it will pill. I haven't been using it long enough to see any significant results but my skin definitely feels nice and soft.
This serum makes my face feel so smooth. I was looking for something to repair my skin from over exfoliating and the harsh sun and so far I am happy with this product.
This serum makes my face feel so smooth. I was looking for something to repair my skin from over exfoliating and the harsh sun and so far I am happy with this product.

Recently I have been getting breakouts on my t-zone considering it's summer and just hot in general. I completely ruined and destroyed my skin barrier, by trying to solve my breakouts over the course of a week. I went to ulta and bought this serum and within a few hours my skin was turning back to normal! No dryness, no redness, no irritation. It does smell a little funny ,but for what it does I couldn't care! For the next few days I am solely just using this serum as a moisturizer so I dont overdo anything. I am so glad I decided to buy this product! Cute side not, I love the pink!
I definitely regret trying this... I washed it off after 10 minutes from application but the damage was done. 4 days later and I'm still nursing my red irritated skin :(
Terrible experience. This product turned my already sensitive skin bright red. It was painful to the touch and really inflamed . Not a fan!!

Made my dry skin very clear and definitely repaired its barrier. My skin felt "stronger" when I used this serum. I could definitely see results even after only about a week of consistency. (Bonus- it's also hot pink!🩷)

avis.titre: Just alright… not a calming skin feel
avis.texte: For me, this product didn't do anything special. It certainly did not negatively impact my skin in any way, but I found after ~4 months of use that I could not tell a difference whether I applied the serum or not. More importantly: on skin that's already irritated, healing from blemishes, etc., I found that for ~10 minutes after applying the product my skin was stinging, red, and a bit inflamed. This would then calm down… but still not the "calming" or healing feel that I was looking for.
I didnt even realize my skin needed this. I tried it just because and my skin looks amazing! It feels smoother and healthier than it ever has.

This imo the best serum The Ordinary has it has completly changed ny skib for the better abd got rid of ALL my acne!!! My only thing is the smell but you get use to it really quick!!! But yes I will be repurchasing many many many times!!
The product is good, if you have sensitive skin I would look into the products before buying this product

I kinda killed my skin doing too much exfoliating and my skin barrier was wrecked. I simplified my routine and started using this 2x a day. 100% im gonna repurchase and keep this as a staple in my routine. The only "complaint" is that the smell is not amazing, but once the serum dries this is no problem at all.

I've had acne prone skin for 10+ years and this is the forst prooduct to make a change. I apply it right after i dry my cleansed skin. It takes away irritation which in turn has prevented more acne to form. I have now repurchased 4x. LOVE
i was over exfoliating and had a damaged skin barrier . this is the only serum that made my skin healthy again loveee it
